sovereign_country.strategic_role: 苏伊士运河经济特区、辐射中东及北非的低成本轻工制造

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Cross-Border Procurement of Culinary and Ceremonial Grade Matcha

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (Civil law system rooted in the Napoleonic Code, with Islamic Sharia as the principal source of legislation and distinct commercial/administrative courts)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: United States – Egypt Bilateral Investment Treaty (entered into force 1992)
United Kingdom – Arab Republic of Egypt Investment Protection and Promotion Agreement
Egypt – European Union Association Agreement (in force 2004)
COMESA Treaty (Egypt is a member state)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 80 of 2002 on Combating Money Laundering (as amended) and its Executive Regulations, including Prime Ministerial Decree No. 950 of 2016, govern AML/CFT and customer due diligence in Egypt; the Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 and GAFI implementing regulations require UBO declarations in all incorporation filings; the Financial Regulatory Authority and the Central Bank of Egypt have issued binding UBO and AML/CFT rulebooks requiring companies to identify, verify, and register every shareholder and beneficial owner holding 25% or more of ownership or control.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of Certificate of Incorporation or equivalent legal existence document for any corporate UBO/shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent foreign company registry in the jurisdiction of incorporation of the UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Hague Apostille is not recognized by Egypt)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Passport copy of each ultimate beneficial owner, proposed director, and authorized signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport authority of the individual UBO/director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized copy followed by Consular Legalization at the Egyptian Embassy or Consulate in the issuing jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or Certificate of Incumbency of any intermediate corporate entity in the ownership chain
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign companies registry or licensed corporate services provider in the intermediate entity's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Egyptian Ministry of Foreign Affairs legalization circuit)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Memorandum of Association and Articles of Incorporation of the proposed Egyptian LLC, together with UBO declaration forms
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: GAFI / Ministry of Justice General Directorate for Notaries
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Arabic notarization and authentication by GAFI, with subsequent legalization by the Egyptian Ministry of Foreign Affairs if the document is required internationally

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based enhanced due diligence is required for all UBOs, directors, and authorized signatories against Egyptian Financial Intelligence Unit indicators, the Egyptian national terrorist lists, UN Security Council sanctions, EU autonomous sanctions, HMT lists, and OFAC SDN/Consolidated screening lists. PEP status, negative press, sourcing of wealth, and jurisdiction risk must be documented before incorporation. Screening alerts escalate to senior management approval and, if unresolved, constitute a prohibition on proceeding with Egyptian incorporation.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: GAFI E-Services Portal and Company Name Reservation Module available through the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones One-Stop-Shop (www.gafi.gov.eg)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All Egyptian company names must be rendered in Arabic script; Latin/English transliteration is supplementary and must phonetically correspond to the approved Arabic name. Foreign names, including the product word 'Matcha', must be transliterated into an accepted Arabic spelling that follows Egyptian orthographic practice and does not constitute a prohibited or misleading compound.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant may file a written grievance with GAFI's Grievance Committee within fifteen working days of the rejection notice, attaching the original name search receipt, corrected Arabic and transliterated options, and any supporting trademark or goodwill evidence. The Grievance Committee must issue a reasoned decision; if the grievance is refused, the applicant may appeal to the State Council Administrative Court within sixty days under Law No. 106 of 2014. The rejected name cannot be used while the appeal is pending, and a single extension of up to thirty days may be requested before the reservation expires.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is accepted only as a supplementary correspondence address. The Egyptian LLC must have a physical registered office in Egypt for service of process, receipt of official communications, statutory records inspection, and access by tax and AML authorities. For an ISIC 4631 matcha distribution entity, a Grade-B serviced office, shared office suite, or a law firm office premises used under a disclosed lease agreement will satisfy the statutory commercial substance requirement.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low_Risk_Standard; estimated annual probability of an unannounced physical on-site inspection is below 10% for a clean, low-risk wholesale distribution entity operating under ISIC 4631. The probability will materially increase to 50–75% upon AML/CFT flags, sanctions hits, UBO discrepancies, tax irregularity alerts, or a targeted Egyptian FIU or tax authority inspection campaign.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Official company name availability search and reservation in Arabic and English transliteration
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: GAFI statutory administrative fee schedule, converted from Egyptian Pounds at the official exchange rate

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization before the Egyptian Notary Public of the Memorandum of Association and UBO declaration forms
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Justice – General Directorate for Notaries
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notarial fee tariff fixed by ministerial decree, based on number of instruments and declared capital

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Arabic translation and legalization of foreign corporate, passport, address, and UBO background documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate per translated page plus notarial attestation fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Consular legalization (authentication) of UBO personal and corporate documents at Egyptian Embassies/Consulates in the relevant foreign jurisdictions
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Egyptian Ministry of Foreign Affairs – Consular Affairs Administration
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Egyptian MOFA consular legalization tariff per document plus courier handling fees

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO ownership-chain analysis and PEP/OFAC/UN/EU/HMT sanctions screening report on all beneficial owners and directors
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External licensed AML/KYC screening provider / Egyptian legal counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for enhanced due diligence research; no statutory tariff applies

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: GAFI electronic filing fee for preliminary incorporation approval and commercial registration clearance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: GAFI statutory fee schedule for LLC incorporation, including electronic and One-Stop-Shop service charges

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial Registry enrollment fee for the LLC and issuance of the commercial register extract
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Trade and Industry – Commercial Registry Department
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory commercial registration tariff based on legal form and number of registrations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Tax card application, VAT registration, and payroll/withholding tax registration formalities
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: ETA administrative issuance fees for tax card and VAT certificate; nominal statutory amounts excluding professional fees

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Filing of Ultimate Beneficial Owner register and AML/CFT compliance file under Law No. 80 of 2002 and GAFI UBO interface
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Egyptian Financial Intelligence Unit / GAFI UBO filing module
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Officially prescribed electronic filing charge and record-keeping compliance fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: First-year serviced registered office in Cairo with statutory mailing address, reception, and meeting room access
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed corporate services provider / office lessor
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing Grade-B serviced office market rate for a twelve-month term

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation due diligence, UBO piercing, name clearance, and procurement of consular legalization by Egyptian licensed counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Egyptian licensed law firm retained by the founders
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed-fee professional retainer based on deal complexity; no statutory tariff applies

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Law No. 4 of 2023 and its Executive Regulations (LLC formation, registration and governance chapters); Commercial Registration Law No. 34 of 1976 (mandatory commercial registration); Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 (facilitation and investor protections); Law No. 17 of 1999 (Commercial Code) regarding traders' records.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) – One-Stop-Shop (OSS), Cairo; Commercial Registry Department, Ministry of Trade and Industry (functionally integrated within the GAFI-OSS formation workflow).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarized Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association (Aqd Al-Taasis wa Al-Nizam Al-Asasi), filed through the GAFI One-Stop-Shop statutory incorporation application and subsequently recorded in the Commercial Registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for Limited Liability Companies under Companies Law No. 4 of 2023; founders determine the share capital in the Memorandum of Association. Capital must be fully subscribed at signature, and the paid-up cash portion must be deposited in a temporary blocked bank account opened in the company-under-formation name in Egypt; funds are released only upon issuance of the Commercial Registration Certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST RESOLUTION OF THE BOARD OF MANAGERS OF [ORGANIC MATCHA TRADING LLC] ADOPTED ON [DATE]. 1. Ratification: The Certificate of Incorporation issued under Companies Law No. 4 of 2023 is ratified, and all pre-incorporation contracts are approved. 2. Share Subscription: The share capital of EGP [amount] divided into [number] shares was fully subscribed per the notarized Memorandum of Association; the capital deposit certificate is adopted. 3. Registered Office: The premises at [Egyptian address] are confirmed as the statutory seat for process service. 4. Officers: [Name A] is appointed Chief Executive Manager and [Name B] Finance Manager with signing authority per the Articles. 5. Administration: Opening of bank accounts and auditor engagement are authorized.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop-Shop (OSS) – online digital services portal or Cairo OSS counter
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a formal name reservation request for the Arabic and English trading names of the LLC. The OSS verifies uniqueness against Commercial Registry records and issues a name reservation certificate valid for 60 days.
required_dossiers: Completed OSS name reservation form
Proposed Arabic and English company names
Copy of founders' passports
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for similarity or public-order grounds, submit an alternative name via an amended reservation form within 5 working days; the first substitution carries no additional fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of Temporary Blocked Capital Account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Egyptian bank selected by the founders (e.g., National Bank of Egypt, Banque Misr)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a 'company under formation' account in the intended company name and deposit the paid-up cash portion of the capital stated in the draft Memorandum of Association. Obtain the bank's certificate of capital deposit identifying all founders and the deposited amount.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association
Passports of signatory founders
Name reservation certificate
AML/CFT source-of-funds declaration and bank account opening forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank issues a query on source of funds, provide certified bank statements and underlying trade documentation; any name or capital discrepancies identified by the bank must be corrected in the draft charter before notarization.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Justice – Real Estate Publicity and Notarization Department (Notary Public Office)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: All founders must appear before the notary public to sign the Memorandum and Articles of Association in Arabic, pay the applicable stamp duty, and obtain notarized certified copies of the charter. The notary verifies legal capacity and the capital deposit certificate.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association in Arabic
Bank capital deposit certificate
Founders' passports or national IDs
Notarial and stamp duty payment receipts
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary flags a defective or ambiguous clause, the charter must be amended by marginal annotation signed by all founders or re-executed; re-notarization generally completes within 1 working day.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: One-Stop-Shop Incorporation Filing and Statutory Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop-Shop (OSS) – Company Registration Department, Cairo
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notarized charter, capital deposit certificate, registered office proof and statutory forms with GAFI-OSS. The OSS processes incorporation concurrently with the Commercial Registry, Tax Authority, Social Insurance Authority and statistical records, then issues the draft commercial registration extract.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association
Capital deposit certificate issued by the bank
Name reservation certificate
Registered office lease contract or title deed
Consent of appointed managers to act
Criminal record certificates of managers (Egyptian Ministry of Interior)
Passports of managers and shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to a deficiency notice within 15 days; if the application is refused, file an administrative appeal to the GAFI internal committee within 30 days and re-submit corrected forms without duplication of the notarization.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registration Certificate and Official Gazette Publication
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial Registry (Ministry of Trade and Industry) accessed through GAFI-OSS
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon OSS clearance, collect the final Commercial Registration Certificate (Qayd Tijari). The OSS publishes a formation summary in the Official Gazette and issues the publication certificate, which provides third-party effectiveness of the incorporation.
required_dossiers: GAFI incorporation clearance approval
Notarized Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association
Commercial Registry fee and publication fee receipts
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Gazette publication is delayed, request issuance of the publication certificate within 10 days; typographical corrections to the published notice are processed administratively without re-notarization.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Activation: Tax Card, Importer Registration and Food-Safety Clearances
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA); General Organization for Export and Import Control (GOEIC); National Food Safety Authority (NFSA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply to ETA for the unified Tax Card (Tax Identification Number) and VAT registration; activate e-invoicing integration. Register with GOEIC as an importer of foodstuffs for ISIC 4631, and submit the NFSA food business registration for the storage premises, including pre-import notification for each matcha consignment subject to NFSA batch-release inspection.
required_dossiers: Commercial registration extract and notarized Memorandum of Association
ETA tax card application forms and registered office lease
Manager's national ID/passport and board authorization
GOEIC importer registration form, company extract and specimen certificate of analysis
NFSA food facility registration file with warehouse layout, hygiene/storage plan, product specification sheets, certificates of origin and laboratory analyses for matcha lots
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If ETA, GOEIC or NFSA issues a query, cure by submitting corrective declarations and third-party laboratory test reports within 10 working days; NFSA registration refusals may be administratively appealed within 60 days, and non-cleared matcha consignments must not be placed on the Egyptian market.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Trade and Industry – General Organization for Export and Import Control (GOEIC) for importer registration; National Food Safety Authority (NFSA) for food-safety facility registration of the trading/storage premises
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: None required – wholesale distribution and storage of packaged matcha powder is non-industrial. Ancillary mandatory registrations: GOEIC Importer Card and NFSA Food Business Operation Registration (Qaid Mancha' Ghadha'i).

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category C – Exempt from EIA screening (wholesale trading and warehousing of packaged dry commodities are not listed in Annexes I or II of Environment Law No. 4 of 1994); no scoping or full EIA report required
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable – no manufacturing process wastewater or VOC emission sources. Sanitary effluent from office/warehouse premises, if any, must comply with municipal sewer standards under Law No. 93 of 1962, and rejected or expired matcha batches must be disposed of under Waste Management Regulation Law No. 202 of 2020; no industrial discharge thresholds are triggered.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the General Administration of Civil Defense for the storage and office premises; structural load inspection certificate for pallet racking and storage areas in line with Egyptian building standards; workplace occupational safety clearance per Labour Law No. 12 of 2003 covering exit routes, fire extinguishers and medical fitness records; food-grade warehousing hygiene clearance issued by NFSA.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) – portal: https://www.eta.gov.eg (The ETA administers income tax, VAT, stamp tax, and payroll taxes under the Unified Tax Procedures Law No. 90 of 2022; e-invoicing portal: invoice.eta.gov.eg)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Egyptian limited liability company must apply to the ETA on the official Tax Card application (ETA Form No. 1) within 30 days of commencing commercial activity. The dossier includes: notarized Arabic incorporation contract (A/S), commercial registration extract, proof of registered office (lease or title deed), board resolution authorizing the tax representative, power of attorney, certified passports/commercial registration of all foreign shareholders, and opening balance sheet. The ETA issues a single unified Tax Card (Bitaqua Dharibiya) bearing a unified Tax Identification Number (TIN) that simultaneously operates as VAT registration number, income tax registration number, and payroll tax ID. Registration must be completed before any invoice issuance and before import/export activity; the tax card must be renewed every 5 years.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation (Egyptian LLC is a resident juridical person taxed on worldwide income at the 22.5% corporate income tax rate under Law No. 91 of 2005; no pass-through or partnership-style tax transparency is available for LLCs; free-zone licensed entities may instead be classified under a Territorial_Scope-equivalent regime with a 5% lump-sum tax on total annual revenue under Investment Law No. 72 of 2017)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch elections exist in Egyptian tax law. Available elections include: (1) free-zone regime election under Law No. 72 of 2017 (Investment Law), converting entity taxation to a 5% lump-sum on gross revenue with VAT/import duty exemptions; (2) small-business simplified income tax regime under Unified Tax Law No. 90 of 2022, available where annual gross receipts do not exceed EGP 20,000,000, taxing turnover at progressive flat rates; (3) participation exemption election on qualifying dividend and capital gains income under Art. 51 of Law No. 91 of 2005; (4) VAT payment on a cash basis for small taxpayers; (5) no VAT grouping or consolidated VAT filing is permitted; foreign shareholders may elect to appoint a resident tax representative for all tax filings.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value Added Tax) under Law No. 67 of 2016, administered by the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 annual value of taxable supplies/goods and services (mandatory VAT registration threshold; voluntary registration available below the threshold under Art. 18 of Law No. 67 of 2016)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory B2B electronic invoicing in real-time: all VAT-registered taxpayers must issue e-invoices in Arabic and English in XML/JSON format through the ETA E-Invoice Portal via certified API integration. Each e-invoice receives a QR code containing the invoice QR-digital signature, is cleared electronically by the ETA (fiscal clearance stamp) within a near-real-time window, and must include the customs export declaration reference for export supplies. The e-receipt system (B2C) and the integration phases are mandatory for all VAT registrants as of the latest ETA enforcement schedules; failure to integrate blocks VAT refunds and exposes the taxpayer to administrative penalties.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: The export threshold for mandatory e-invoicing integration is all VAT registrants; there is no separate lower threshold.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export of goods (including organic matcha powder) is zero-rated under Art. 25(1) of the VAT Law No. 67 of 2016 where goods physically leave Egypt within 90 days from the date of the export invoice (extendable to 180 days with prior ETA approval). The exporter must hold a valid Egyptian VAT registration certificate, issue a compliant export e-invoice, and prove that legal ownership of the goods was transferred to a non-resident buyer. Offshore services supplied to non-residents can be zero-rated where the beneficiary is located abroad and use occurs outside Egypt, subject to ETA documentary checks.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (official export entry raised via Egypt Customs ACI system)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical export from Egypt
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank transfer documentation proving receipt of export proceeds in foreign currency to an Egyptian bank
Exported e-invoice bearing the ETA QR code and customs declaration number
Commercial invoice, purchase order/contract, and packing list
Certificate of Origin (where required by the destination market)
Vegetable/health and phytosanitary certificate for organic food product, where required by Egyptian agricultural quarantine
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: ETA audit reviews export files within the five-year statutory limitation period and may cross-match customs ACI data, shipping manifests, bank FX receipts, and e-invoices. Any false export claim, overstatement of exported quantity, or failure to repatriate proceeds within the 180-day CBE deadline triggers retrospective clawback of the 14% VAT previously zero-rated, plus monthly delay surcharge (up to 2% per month, non-deductible) and a fine of EGP 20,000 to EGP 2,000,000 and up to 5 years' imprisonment in the case of deliberate evasion under Law No. 90 of 2022. The offending exporter is also blacklisted from the e-invoicing/refund system and loses export refund priority.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Egypt operates a managed floating exchange rate regime supervised by the CBE. Current account transactions, including trade settlements and profit remittances, are generally convertible with standard documentation. Capital account transactions require prior CBE approval. Profit remittances to non-resident shareholders are subject to 15% withholding tax and mandatory repatriation formalities; amounts above certain thresholds trigger enhanced CBE reporting and potential delays.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Exporters must surrender 100% of foreign exchange proceeds from eligible exports to authorized Egyptian banks within six months of shipment date. Mandatory conversion occurs at the prevailing CBE reference rate. Required documentation includes commercial invoices, packing lists, bills of lading, and proof of delivery. Non-compliance results in penalties, account restrictions, and barriers to future export financing.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Fintech EMI cross-border viability is low. CBE imposes strict licensing, minimum capital, and AML requirements on electronic money institutions. Offshore digital EMIs are prohibited without local bank partnerships; any cross-border operations require full CBE authorization and ongoing compliance reporting.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Directors, shareholders, and authorized signatories must attend physical branch visits for KYC interviews and account opening. Remote corporate account opening is not permitted under Egyptian regulations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inconsistent beneficial ownership or source of funds
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of incorporation, notarized passport copies, proof of address, board resolutions, and audited financial statements

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Connections to high-risk jurisdictions or sanctions lists
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Enhanced due diligence reports, beneficial ownership verification certificates, transaction pattern analysis, and legal opinions confirming clean ownership

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections routed via SWIFT MT103 or TT transfers must use purpose codes 'CAP' or 'EQU'. Verification requires board resolutions, investment agreements, and source-of-funds evidence. All transactions processed through licensed Egyptian banks with full CBE FX reporting compliance.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade disbursements settled via SWIFT MT103 with purpose code 'TRA' or 'PAY'. Commercial letters of credit issued through correspondent banks using underlying trade documents. FX conversion for settlements requires CBE approval and supporting export/import documentation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return with audited financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months following the end of the fiscal year (anniversary-based for each LLC fiscal year)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 2% of unpaid tax per month, plus a fixed penalty of EGP 3,000 to EGP 30,000; persistent non-filing triggers administrative enforcement and potential license suspension

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements filing (balance sheet and profit and loss)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months from the end of the fiscal year for LLCs subject to audit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file triggers fines under GAFI regulations and blocks annual commercial registry renewal; repeated omission may lead to administrative strike-off

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Commercial registry annual renewal of registration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registry, Ministry of Trade and Industry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by the end of the month following the anniversary of original registration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal penalties accrue daily; after 60 days of non-renewal, the registry may administratively strike off the entity

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within 30 days after the anniversary of registration, plus prompt filing within 30 days of any shareholding transfer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing or failure to update beneficial ownership data may result in fines of up to EGP 100,000 and prohibition on further corporate actions

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: All Egyptian LLCs are required to prepare audited financial statements if annual turnover exceeds EGP 20 million; companies with lower turnover may be exempt unless shareholders holding at least 10% demand an audit or the entity operates in regulated sectors
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS), converged with IFRS framework

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Each LLC must maintain a beneficial ownership register and file an annual confirmation with GAFI identifying all persons holding more than 25% equity or exercising significant control. The confirmation is due within 30 days of the registration anniversary and must be updated within 30 days of any shareholding transfer.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,000-6,000 per year for a certified audit

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 22.5% (20% on the first EGP 10 million of annual taxable income; 22.5% on the excess)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory tax holiday specific to wholesale matcha trading; general incentives under Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 allow a 30% to 50% deduction of qualifying capital investment costs for industrial, logistics, and export-oriented projects in Governorates A and B; Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZone) and free-zone registrants may access customs duty exemptions and zero-rating of VAT on imported capital equipment; depreciation, bad-debt provisions, and 5-year loss carry-forward remain the principal reliefs available to the ordinary Egyptian LLC.
